requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the classes A1 through C are included.
The user wants the building near public transport. The value is the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence is expected to be close to universities and schools. The value is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are left to other agents. The city of Turin is a geographic criterion handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili', the filterable equivalent of tipologia_bene_immobile) with surface_area >= 850, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy_class A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the given coordinates. The 60-occupant capacity is not an extracted requirement, so it is not filtered.
